slides.headline: The ugly cut taught us more.
slides.body: Polish is a second draft, not a personality.

slides.headline: Waiting looked like taste.
slides.body:
Another pass on the logo while nobody used it.

slides.headline: Ugly, then less ugly.
slides.body:
Mon | Post the rough cut.
Wed | Read every reply.
Fri | Change the thing they named.

slides.headline: Real notes beat a quiet launch.
slides.body: Silence is not a sign of quality.
